quests.en: Take Grandpa forest's order outside the workshop.
quests.zh: 到工坊外接取 forest 爷爷的订单。

quests.en: Follow the dirt path to find wood for the chair.
quests.zh: 沿着土路寻找制作椅子所需的木材。

quests.en: Cut the mushroom with the saw.
Bring the log back to the workshop.
Place the log on the machine.
Take a workstation each and saw the log together.
quests.zh: 两人各就各位，一起锯开原木。

quests.en: Bring the cut logs to the assembler flower.
quests.zh: 把切好的木段送到组装花处。

quests.en: Pull the ropes to activate the assembler.
Deliver the package to Grandpa forest.
quests.zh: 把包裹交给 forest 爷爷。

return_to_game.en: Press H to close keyboard help.
return_to_game.zh: 按 H 关闭键盘帮助。

keyboard_guide: SHARED KEYBOARD / 双人共用键盘
P1 WASD  |  P2 ARROWS / 方向键  —  Move / 移动
P1 E  |  P2 J  —  Pick up / drop / 拾取或放下
P1 F  |  P2 K  —  Interact; join / leave station / 交互；站位或退出
P1 SPACE  |  P2 RIGHT SHIFT  —  Jump; pull rope / 跳跃；拉绳
P1 Q / R  |  P2 U / O  —  Left / right hand / 左右手
TREE / 双人取材: P1 A / D; P2 LEFT / RIGHT / 左右交替
SAW / 锯木机: crank = directions; blade = jump key / 转轮用方向键，刀位用跳跃键
ROPE / 组装拉绳: take one rope each; press together / 两人各站一条绳，按跳跃键配合
TAB Objectives / 任务显示  |  P Pause / 暂停  |  H Help / 帮助
